flows: direct regional boundary-crossing series, not sum of municipalities
population_definition: DEM0026B December 31 in row year; downstream forecasts must use only earlier rows
units: persons (osoba), as specified in official 130141-23dds.docx; migration event counts are not necessarily unique people
category_validation: no age/sex dimensions; actual CSV schema invariant over all22years; selected one total record per indicator/territory/year; no subgroup summation
schema_note: Official schema says vuk_txt but actual files consistently use vuk_text
notes: Historical retrospective series, not real-time 2021 vintage
2000/2001 scope break: foreigners with visas over 90 days and asylum added from 2001
2005 migration source changed to administrative data
Territorial composition follows January 1 of each year; census revisions 2001/2011/2021 affect population
No age/sex dimensions in these yearly CSV schemas; each region/indicator selected exactly once
